answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity with escalating entry bonds. Each new agent must lock a bond that grows with every additional identity claiming the same sponsor, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. An attacker farming many sybils faces compounding capital costs, like a comet dragging a heavier tail the faster it moves. Honest agents recover bonds as their orchard of attestations ripens, while fake identities leave a pigment of suspicion that peers detect and refuse to endorse, making mass forgery economically irrational.
